identification.summary: FOXY PANDA is a CrowdStrike-style adversary name that Malpedia describes as a group targeting telecommunication and technology organizations [S1][S2].
identification.notes: Malpedia lists POISONUS PANDA as a synonym and cites a 2016 CrowdStrike presentation, 'Detecting and Responding: Pandas and Bears', as its reference [S1]. Do not confuse with LIMINAL PANDA or PHANTOM PANDA, which are separate CrowdStrike telecom-focused clusters.

attribution.basis: Strobes tags the actor as China-linked (CN) [S2]. No source gathered states a sponsoring agency or an attribution confidence level.

targeting.notes: Sector focus only, as stated by Malpedia and Strobes [S1][S2]. No victim regions or named victims found.

diamond.adversary: China-linked actor per Strobes tag; no operator or organization identified [S2].

gaps: No public CrowdStrike adversary profile for FOXY PANDA was found; the only reference is a 2016 presentation I could not open.
Malpedia and Strobes pages could not be fetched (host resolution failed); content relies on search-result summaries only.
The SANS Summit PDF listed in the existing record was not seen in search results and was not verified.
Tooling, campaigns, victims, infrastructure, first-observed date, MITRE group ID and Microsoft mapping are all unknown.
Relationship to POISONUS PANDA, and to any Microsoft-named actor, is unverified.
